# Appendix: Ask Us Anything

Questions are edited for clarity.

## Questions for us

**What are the odds we see another card hunt? PLEASE :)**

> I’m not saying never, but after all the chaos of 2023, I’d be a bit cautious.

**Inspirations for the characters themselves?**

> For most Celestials, the puzzles were written first, then the characters were designed after to fit. The exceptions were Rock Lobster, who was there because we needed a Rock Lobster puzzle, and Pom Pom and Mop Mop, who were very cute.

**Favorite star?**

> Alnilam.

> Lonely Rolling Star.

> Craft II.

> When you draw a pentagram using the lasso tool on various software tools except the middle pentagon gets omitted from your selection.

> Robin Starveling.

> Anything but Deneb \>:(

**Who’s your Hololive oshis?**

> [hololive karaoke but with northernlion (plz dont click vtubers inside)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O-tbDYejJA0)

**What was the process for the sound design?**

> Amon here, I made the sounds last year and this year. Last year’s sounds were a mix of synths, recorded mouth sounds, and free sound effects, and this year almost everything you heard were synths. There are many rich synth presets in the Analog Lab software (the Play version is free) bundled with my MIDI keyboard, and I layered a bunch for the “common wish” notification. If I were mixing a more professional recording I might use Ableton Live (the Lite version is free), but Audacity (also free) was fine for some light panning and dynamics (and faster for me to use).
>
> Thursday night before hunt start, some of us asked for the sounds to be more “epic” with higher rarity wishes. I made a note to try but then I forgot about it until Friday morning (of hunt start) when CJ reminded me. I think I was distracted helping make the victory certificates? Anyways, I spent an hour throwing whatever random cool presets on top of the existing common wish sound, and ended up with:
>
> - common: four spacey layers of two alien whines and a light arpeggio doubled and hard panned to both sides
> - uncommon: add arpeggio harmony, wind chimes
> - rare: add two percussive booms
> - epic: add a synthwave beat and a light drum groove
> - legendary & celestials: add the ridiculous DnB loop
>
> <SFXTester />
>
> So yeah, these got added about two hours before the hunt started. Glad many of you enjoyed it\!

> We received so many hint requests and custom puzzle submissions that many of us were able to hallucinate the “admin queue” sound during the hunt. In fact, teams are still occasionally submitting hint requests now (which still plays the sound for us while automatically closing the hint) and it always gives me a jumpscare.

**How on earth did you manage to answer all the hints within a few minutes of receipt, including for user-submitted puzzles? Across all of the teams, there were OVER 9000 requests\!**

> Free Yannick. Or perhaps it should be “Free Wayne”?

> We’ve streamlined our interface to make it easy to answer hint requests quickly; it lets us look at the puzzle, solution, canned hints, previous guesses, and other hint requests all at once.

**Is Olive a Sparklemuffin?**

> Yes\!

**Who is Kero? They’re just a little fish and they’re so cute. I want to know more about them.**

> Kero is a magic carp who was guarding a treasure chest in [Galactic Puzzle Hunt 2023](https://2023.galacticpuzzlehunt.com/). He is a master of the power of uwu. He is hiding somewhere in 2024 if you can find him.

**Are the puzzle titles the actual names for the stars?**

> We submitted our suggestions to the IAU but they didn’t seem to think “A Sudoku With Only 8 Hidden Digits\!?” was an appropriate name for a star.

**If we didn’t finish, did we ruin all of their friendships?**

> If you don’t finish the hunt, you won’t be caught up to the current state of the Galactic Puzzle Hunt Extended Cinematic Universe. At least go watch the cutscenes\!
